questions.question: If 4sintheta + csctheta = 4 , 0° sin 3theta + cos 3theta is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The equation **4sinθ + 1/sinθ = 4** is in the form **x + 1/x = 2** where **x = 2sinθ**.

This standard form implies **x = 1**, which means **2sinθ = 1** or **sinθ = 1/2**.

For the range **0° < θ < 90°**, the value of **θ** is **30°**.

Substitute **θ = 30°** in the required expression: **sin(3 × 30°) + cos(3 × 30°)**.

**sin 90° + cos 90° = 1 + 0 = 1**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

questions.question: Two bells are rung at intervals of 1,764 seconds and 2,268 seconds, respectively. They are rung together at the start. After how much time will the two bells ring together again for the first time?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find when the **bells ring together** again, calculate the **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** of the two time intervals.

Find the common factor: 1764 = 252 × 7 and 2268 = 252 × 9.

**LCM** = 252 × 7 × 9 = 252 × 63 = 15876 seconds.

Convert 15876 seconds: 15876 ÷ 3600 = 4 hours, remainder 1476; 1476 ÷ 60 = 24 minutes, remainder 36 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hr 24 min 36 sec.**

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 4 : 13 : 9, and their LCM is 6084. Their HCF is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the ratio parts are **pairwise coprime** (meaning no two parts share a common factor), the **LCM** is simply the **HCF × Product of Ratio Parts**.

Ratio parts 4, 13, and 9 are pairwise coprime.

⇒ 6084 = HCF × (4 × 13 × 9)

⇒ 6084 = HCF × 468

⇒ HCF = 6084 ÷ 468 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

questions.question: Pipes X, Y, and Z together can fill a tank in 8 hours. If all three work together for 3 hours, and then pipe Z is closed, the remaining tank is filled by X and Y in 10 hours. In how many hours can pipe Z alone fill the empty tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work done by **Pipes X, Y, and Z** in 3 hr = 3/8 part.

Remaining work = 1 − 3/8 = 5/8 part.

**X and Y** fill 5/8 part in 10 hr ⇒ full tank in 10 × 8/5 = 16 hr.

Efficiency of **pipe Z** = 1/8 − 1/16 = 1/16.

Time taken by **pipe Z** alone = 16 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (**X+Y+Z**) = 8 hr

Work done by (**X+Y+Z**) in 3 hr = 3/8

Remaining work = 1 − 3/8 = 5/8

Time taken by (**X+Y**) to fill 5/8 part = 10 hr

⇒ Time for (**X+Y**) to fill full tank = 10 × 8/5 = 16 hr

**Calculations:**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days (hr)**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **X+Y+Z**
 8
 16
 16 ÷ 8 = 2
 
 

 **X+Y**
 16
 16 ÷ 16 = 1
 
 

⇒ Efficiency of **pipe Z** = Efficiency of (**X+Y+Z**) − Efficiency of (**X+Y**)

⇒ Efficiency of **pipe Z** = 2 − 1 = 1

⇒ Time taken by **pipe Z** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of Z

⇒ Time = 16 ÷ 1 = 16 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 16 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work, Time, and Efficiency Relationship

The total work is the product of efficiency and time (Work = Efficiency × Time). Efficiency is the amount of work done in a unit of time.

Combined Rate Rule

When multiple pipes work together, their combined efficiency is the sum of their individual efficiencies: Eₜₒₜₐₗ = E₁ + E₂ + E₃.

Inlet vs. Outlet Pipes

Inlet pipes (filling) have positive efficiency, while outlet pipes (emptying/leakage) have negative efficiency in calculation.

questions.question: The perimeter of a rhombus is 100 meters and one of its diagonals is 14 meters long. What is the length of the other diagonal?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Perimeter** of 100 m ⇒ **Side** = 100 ÷ 4 = 25 m.

Given one **diagonal** is 14 m ⇒ half-diagonal = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 m.

Using the **Pythagorean triplet** (7, 24, 25), the other half-diagonal is 24 m.

Length of the other diagonal = 24 × 2 = 48 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 m.**

questions.question: Two taps can fill a cistern in 2 hours and 37 hours, respectively. A third tap can empty it in 37 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill half of the empty cistern if all the taps are opened together?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Since **Tap 2** (fills in 37 hr) and **Tap 3** (empties in 37 hr) have the same rate, they **cancel each other** out completely. The net filling depends only on **Tap 1**, which fills the **full cistern** in **2 hr**. To fill **half of the cistern**, the time taken is simply half of the total time for Tap 1. Required Time = 2 hr ÷ 2 = **1 hr**. **∴ The correct answer is 1 hr.**

questions.question: A streaming service charges ₹150 per month. If you buy an annual plan (12 months) with a 15% discount, what is your total savings (in ₹) compared to paying monthly for a year?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total cost for 12 months = 150 × 12 = **₹1800**.

Savings = **Discount %** of **Total Cost**.

Savings = 15% of 1800 = 15 × 18 = **₹270**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹270.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Monthly charge** = ₹150

**Duration** = 12 months

**Discount rate** = 15%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef21a14bd3bab2a8f5378861996a140a36159a9d1f22f4db6a6b98ceff4e23e9.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total cost without discount = 150 × 12

⇒ Total cost = **₹1800**

⇒ Total savings = 15% of 1800

⇒ Savings = (15 ÷ 100) × 1800

⇒ Savings = 15 × 18 = **₹270**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹270.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Discount Formula

Discount Amount = (Discount % ÷ 100) × Marked Price. It represents the reduction in the original price.

Net Payable Amount

The Final Price (Selling Price) = Original Price − Discount Amount, or Final Price = Original Price × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.

Successive Discounts

When two discounts a% and b% are applied sequentially, the equivalent single discount is given by (a + b − ab/100)%.

questions.question: The sum of two positive numbers is 27 and their product is 170. The positive difference between them is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify factors of the **product** 170 that add up to the **sum** 27.

170 = 17 × 10

Checking the sum: 17 + 10 = 27 (Satisfied)

Required **positive difference**: 17 − 10 = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the two **positive numbers** be x and y.

**Given:** x + y = 27 and xy = 170

**Formula Used:** (x − y)² = (x + y)² − 4xy

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fbfb5981c5be9211fb190baf2ecf2c2082ce25cb3dd4203d466943fc1bc0a1e.png] 

⇒ (x − y)² = (27)² − 4 × 170

⇒ (x − y)² = 729 − 680

⇒ (x − y)² = 49

⇒ x − y = √49

⇒ x − y = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity Relation

The relation between sum, difference, and product of two numbers is given by: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

Quadratic Equation Formation

If the sum (S) and product (P) of two numbers are known, the numbers are the roots of the quadratic equation: t² − St + P = 0.

Sum of Squares

The sum of the squares of the numbers can be calculated as: x² + y² = (x + y)² − 2xy. In this case, 27² − 2(170) = 729 − 340 = 389.

questions.question: The value of a machine depreciates by 10% every year. What is the total percentage depreciation after 2 years?

questions.question: If a triangle has sides a, b, c, and fixed sum a + b + c = 18, then the maximum possible area (in cm²) of the triangle is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a fixed perimeter, the area of a triangle is **maximized** when it is an **equilateral triangle**.

Side of the equilateral triangle = **Perimeter ÷ 3** = 18 ÷ 3 = 6 cm.

Maximum Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × side²

Maximum Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 6² = (√3 ÷ 4) × 36 = 9√3 cm².

∴ The correct answer is 9√3 cm<

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is completely divisible by 6?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by **6** if it is both **even** (divisible by 2) and the **sum of its digits** is divisible by 3.

Checking 7,53,216: It is **even** (ends in 6). Sum of digits = 7 + 5 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 6 = 24 (divisible by 3).

Checking other options: 5,47,821 is **odd**; 6,42,538 (sum=28) and 8,91,452 (sum=29) are **not divisible by 3**.

**∴ The correct answer is 7,53,216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Numbers:** 7,53,216, 6,42,538, 8,91,452, 5,47,821

A number is divisible by 6 if it satisfies two **divisibility rules** simultaneously:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e51ad4bc6d8c61ce8d5970fa996b5ac323410c56a3c5f96c5b71414b7a88eaaf.png] 

**Step-by-step verification for 7,53,216:**

⇒ **Condition 1 (Divisibility by 2):** The last digit is 6, which is even. ⇒ **Passed**.

⇒ **Condition 2 (Divisibility by 3):** Sum of digits = 7 + 5 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 6 = 24.

⇒ 24 ÷ 3 = 8 (No remainder). ⇒ **Passed**.

⇒ Since both conditions are satisfied, the number is divisible by 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 7,53,216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits are divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8.

Divisibility by 9

Similar to the rule for 3, a number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 9.

Divisibility by 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

questions.question: A dealer sells a product at 15% profit. If he had bought it at 10% less and sold it for ₹126 less, he would have gained 20%. Find the cost price.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume initial **Cost Price** = 100 units

Initial SP = 115 units and New CP = 90 units (10% less)

New SP = 90 × 120% = 108 units (20% gain)

Difference in SP = 115 − 108 = 7 units

7 units = ₹126 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹18 ⇒ 100 units = ₹1,800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Profit = 15%, Reduction in CP = 10%, Reduction in SP = ₹126, New Profit = 20%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d07b370c9348c0b54fe8c3c093432ea88e22ec849ff9e3746b59117b47627d0b.png] 

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of the product be ₹ x

⇒ Initial Selling Price (SP₁) = x + 15% of x = 1.15x

⇒ New Cost Price (CP₂) = x − 10% of x = 0.90x

⇒ New Selling Price (SP₂) = 0.90x + 20% of 0.90x

⇒ SP₂ = 0.90x × (120/100) = 1.08x

⇒ According to the question: SP₁ − SP₂ = 126

⇒ 1.15x − 1.08x = 126

⇒ 0.07x = 126

⇒ x = 126 ÷ 0.07

⇒ x = 12600 ÷ 7 = 1800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Formulas

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 and SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.

Net Percentage Change

When a value changes by a% and then b%, the net change is given by (a + b + ab/100)%.

Relationship between CP and MP

CP ÷ MP = (100 − Discount%) ÷ (100 + Profit%). This is used for problems involving markup and discount.

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following schemes on toys of the same marked price.

(A) Successive discounts of 16% and 29% on any number of toys bought.

(B) Successive discounts of 4%, 34% and 37% on any number of toys bought.

(C) 12% discount on the first 4 toys and 27% discount on each toy thereon.

(D) 4 toys free of cost on buying 10 toys.

A customer wants to buy 10 toys. Which of the above schemes is the least beneficial to her?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare the **effective discount percentage** for each scheme on 10 toys:

(A) 16 + 29 − (16 × 29)/100 = 45 − 4.64 = **40.36%**

(B) Effective of (4, 34, 37) is approx. **60.1%** (high discount)

(C) Average discount = [(4 × 12%) + (6 × 27%)] ÷ 10 = (48 + 162) ÷ 10 = **21%**

(D) Discount = [Free ÷ Total] × 100 = (4 ÷ 14) × 100 ≈ **28.57%**

The **least beneficial** scheme is the one with the **lowest discount percentage**.

**∴ The correct answer is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total toys to buy = 10. Let **Marked Price (MP)** of 1 toy = ₹100. Total MP = ₹1000.

**Formula Used:** Effective Discount = (Total Discount ÷ Total MP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e702d8a785f3c4b286e4041ee23c639f9d56ac1b5dcd5fd3c1102342d53d85e8.png] 

**Calculations:**

**Scheme (A):** Successive 16% and 29%

⇒ Net Discount = 16 + 29 − (16 × 29)/100 = 45 − 4.64 = 40.36%

**Scheme (B):** Successive 4%, 34% and 37%

⇒ First two: 4 + 34 − (4 × 34)/100 = 36.64%

⇒ Final: 36.64 + 37 − (36.64 × 37)/100 = 73.64 − 13.55 = 60.09%

**Scheme (C):** 12% on 4 toys and 27% on 6 toys

⇒ Discount on 4 toys = 4 × 12 = ₹48

⇒ Discount on 6 toys = 6 × 27 = ₹162

⇒ Total Discount = 48 + 162 = ₹210

⇒ Effective Discount % = (210 ÷ 1000) × 100 = 21%

**Scheme (D):** 4 toys free on buying 10 toys

⇒ Effective Discount % = [Free ÷ (Paid + Free)] × 100

⇒ Discount % = [4 ÷ (10 + 4)] × 100 = 400 ÷ 14 ≈ 28.57%

Comparing all, **Scheme C** offers the **minimum discount (21%)**, making it the **least beneficial** for the customer.

**∴ The correct answer is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts a% and b%, the equivalent single discount is [a + b − (ab/100)]%.

Buy X Get Y Free

In such schemes, the effective discount percentage is calculated as [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100.

Customer's Benefit

A scheme is **most beneficial** when the **discount is maximum** and **least beneficial** when the **discount is minimum**.

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5. If 6 is subtracted from each, the resulting numbers are in the ratio 1 : 2. Find the difference between the two original numbers.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial **Ratio** = 3 : 5 (Difference = 2 units)

Final **Ratio** = 1 : 2 (Difference = 1 unit)

Equating the difference by multiplying the final ratio by 2: 1 × 2 : 2 × 2 = 2 : 4

Comparison: 3 → 2 and 5 → 4 (Decrease of 1 unit = 6)

Original **Difference** = 5 − 3 = 2 units ⇒ 2 × 6 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **Ratio** of numbers = 3 : 5

Value **subtracted** from each = 6

Resulting **Ratio** = 1 : 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c851f84b88c2fcb49187f3437f250f8afa6800f005267bdceb40f9b6b17cfdea.png] 

**Formula Used:**

If ratio is a : b, numbers are ax and bx. Difference = (b − a)x

**Calculations:**

Let the two numbers be 3x and 5x.

⇒ (3x − 6) / (5x − 6) = 1 / 2

⇒ 2 × (3x − 6) = 1 × (5x − 6)

⇒ 6x − 12 = 5x − 6

⇒ 6x − 5x = 12 − 6

⇒ x = 6

⇒ Original **Difference** = 5x − 3x = 2x

⇒ 2 × 6 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Difference Property

When the same quantity is added to or subtracted from both terms of a **ratio**, the absolute difference between the terms remains a constant multiple of the common variable x.

Cross-Multiplication Method

For any ratio problem involving changes, the **Cross-product** method (Product of extremes = Product of means) is the most reliable way to set up the linear equation.

Proportionality

A **proportion** is an equality of two ratios. If a/b = c/d, then a × d = b × c.

questions.question: Which of the ratios given below is the greatest among them?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratios: **4 : 7**, **3 : 5**, **5 : 8**, and **7 : 1**

**Formula used:**

Ratio **a : b** = **a ÷ b**

**Calculation:**

To determine the **greatest ratio**, convert each into its **decimal equivalent**:

4 : 7 ⇒ 4 ÷ 7 ≈ 0.571

3 : 5 ⇒ 3 ÷ 5 = 0.6

5 : 8 ⇒ 5 ÷ 8 = 0.625

7 : 1 ⇒ 7 ÷ 1 = 7.0

Comparing these **decimal values**:

⇒ 7.0 > 0.625 > 0.6 > 0.571

The **largest value** is 7.0, which corresponds to the ratio **7 : 1**.

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question:
Find the diameter of a sphere of surface area 28962 cm². (round off to the closest integer)

(Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area of a **sphere** in terms of **diameter** (d) is π × d².

28962 ≈ (22/7) × d²

d² ≈ (28962 × 7) ÷ 22 ≈ 9215.18

Since 96² = 9216, the **diameter** d ≈ 96 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 96 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface Area (SA) of the **sphere** = 28962 cm²

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of **sphere** = 4 × π × r²

**Diameter** (d) = 2 × r

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84a998ee7bce68f83184da897167b85932d8ff433325f476b0c224d79a0d51c9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × r²

⇒ 28962 = (88/7) × r²

⇒ r² = (28962 × 7) ÷ 88

⇒ r² = 202734 ÷ 88

⇒ r² = 2303.795

⇒ r = √2303.795 ≈ 47.997

⇒ **Diameter** (d) = 2 × r

⇒ d = 2 × 47.997 = 95.994

⇒ Rounding to the **closest integer**, d ≈ 96 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 96 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume (V) of a sphere is given by the formula V = (4/3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Surface Area

For a solid **hemisphere**, Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr² and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr².

Circle vs Sphere

A circle is a 2D shape with **area** πr², while a sphere is its 3D counterpart with **surface area** 4πr².

questions.question: Simplify the following expression using the BODMAS rule: (3)/(4) + ((5)/(6) times (9)/(10)) - (2)/(3)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

questions.question: A train of length 180 meters is running at a speed of 72 km/h. How much time will it take to cross a bridge 350 meters long?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = **Train length** + **Bridge length** = 180 + 350 = 530 m.

**Speed** in **m/s** = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s.

Required **Time taken** = 530 ÷ 20 = 26.5 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 26.5 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Train length** = 180 m

**Bridge length** = 350 m

**Speed** = 72 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = **Total Distance** ÷ **Speed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/327354d643abc0d53e5fc39530f3bd3006e3511092ab72ef6490764d5cf7cdd8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Total distance** to cross = 180 + 350 = 530 m

⇒ **Speed** in **m/s** = 72 × (5 ÷ 18) = 20 m/s

⇒ **Time taken** = 530 ÷ 20

⇒ **Time taken** = 26.5 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 26.5 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s** to **km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed is the difference. In **opposite directions**, it is the sum.

Distance Concept

When crossing stationary objects like a **platform** or **tunnel**, total distance is the sum of the **train length** and the object length.

questions.question: A person walks from point P to Q at 5 km/hr and returns from Q to P along the same route jogging at 10 km/hr. If the total time taken is 3 hours, what is the distance between P and Q?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** for equal distances = (2 × s₁ × s₂) ÷ (s₁ + s₂)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 5 × 10) ÷ (5 + 10) = 100 ÷ 15 = 20/3 km/hr.

**Total Distance** covered (round trip) = Average Speed × Total Time = (20/3) × 3 = 20 km.

Distance between **Point P** and **Point Q** = Total Distance ÷ 2 = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from **P to Q** (s₁) = 5 km/hr

Speed from **Q to P** (s₂) = 10 km/hr

**Total Time** (T) = 3 hr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16c8fcc9b26ec68a48e70bbe8770f766af423deb488c0c13d88abbd4261f76ed.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Let the **Distance** between P and Q be 'd' km.

⇒ Time taken from P to Q (t₁) = d ÷ 5

⇒ Time taken from Q to P (t₂) = d ÷ 10

⇒ Total Time = t₁ + t₂ = 3

⇒ d/5 + d/10 = 3

⇒ (2d + d) ÷ 10 = 3

⇒ 3d ÷ 10 = 3

⇒ 3d = 30

⇒ d = 10 km

**∴ The correct answer is 10 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

When a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed for the whole journey is given by 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Ratio of Speed and Time

If the distance is constant, the ratio of speeds is inversely proportional to the ratio of time taken (Speed₁ : Speed₂ = Time₂ : Time₁).

Average Speed (Equal Time Intervals)

When a person travels for two equal time intervals at speeds x and y, the average speed is the arithmetic mean (x + y) ÷ 2.

questions.question: The present age of a man is 4 years more than twice the present age of his son. After 6 years, the sum of their ages will be 58 years. What is the present age of the son?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **present sum of ages** is 58 − (2 × 6) = 46 years.

If the son is **s**, then the man is **2s + 4**.

Sum: s + 2s + 4 = 46 ⇒ 3s = 42 ⇒ s = 14.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present age relationship: **Man = 2 × Son + 4**

Future sum (after 6 years): **58 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139941dcdbb5a91e4cd9f4a3cbe44a471abdc62c7636d42c6d0e0adb4187c398.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **present age** of the son be **x** years.

⇒ The **present age** of the man = **2x + 4** years.

⇒ After 6 years, son's age = **x + 6**.

⇒ After 6 years, man's age = (2x + 4) + 6 = **2x + 10**.

⇒ Sum of their ages after 6 years = (x + 6) + (2x + 10) = 58.

⇒ 3x + 16 = 58.

⇒ 3x = 58 − 16.

⇒ 3x = 42.

⇒ x = 42 ÷ 3 = 14.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Sum Calculation

When calculating the **sum of ages** after **n** years for **k** people, the sum increases by **n × k**. For two people, the sum increases by 2n.

Linear Equations in Ages

Age problems are typically solved by assigning a variable to the **youngest person's** present age to simplify the algebraic expression.

Age Ratio Rule

The **difference between the ages** of two individuals remains **constant** at any point in time, regardless of how many years pass.

questions.question: A fruit seller sold mangoes at ₹600 per box last month. This month, he first increased the price by 10% due to transportation costs and then offered a discount of 15% on the increased price. What is the final price of one box of mangoes?

questions.question: The 7-digit number 46A484B is divisible by 24. What is the minimum value of (A + B)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by **24**, it must be divisible by both **3** and **8**.

**Divisibility by 8:** Last three digits **84B** ÷ 8 ⇒ **B** can be **0** or **8**.

**Divisibility by 3:** Sum of digits (4 + 6 + A + 4 + 8 + 4 + B) = **26 + A + B** must be a multiple of 3.

To find the **minimum (A + B)**, we test **B = 0**: 26 + A + 0 = 27 (nearest multiple) ⇒ **A = 1**.

Then, **A + B = 1 + 0 = 1**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The 7-digit number **46A484B** is divisible by **24**.

**Formula Used:** Divisibility rules for **3** and **8** (since 24 = 3 × 8).

**Calculations:**

⇒ For **divisibility by 8**, the last three digits **84B** must be divisible by 8.

⇒ 840 ÷ 8 = 105 (Remainder 0), so **B = 0** is possible.

⇒ 848 ÷ 8 = 106 (Remainder 0), so **B = 8** is possible.

⇒ For **divisibility by 3**, sum of digits = 4 + 6 + A + 4 + 8 + 4 + B = **26 + A + B**.

⇒ If **B = 0**, Sum = 26 + A. The smallest **A** making this divisible by 3 is **A = 1** (as 26 + 1 = 27).

⇒ In this case, **A + B = 1 + 0 = 1**.

⇒ If **B = 8**, Sum = 26 + A + 8 = 34 + A. The smallest **A** making this divisible by 3 is **A = 2** (as 34 + 2 = 36).

⇒ In this case, **A + B = 2 + 8 = 10**.

⇒ Comparing both cases, the **minimum value of (A + B)** is **1**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if its **last three digits** form a number that is divisible by 8 or if the last three digits are 000.

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of all its digits** is a multiple of 3.

Composite Divisibility

To check divisibility by a composite number like **24**, check divisibility by its **co-prime factors** (e.g., 3 and 8, where HCF is 1).

questions.question: Sunil purchased a microwave oven for ₹7,000. He spent ₹400 on its transportation and ₹600 on repairs. He sold the oven for ₹9,800. What is his percentage profit on total investment?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Investment** (CP) = 7000 + 400 + 600 = ₹8000

Selling Price (SP) = ₹9800

Profit = 9800 − 8000 = ₹1800

Profit % = (1800 ÷ 8000) × 100 = 22.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 22.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Purchase Price of **microwave oven** = ₹7,000

**Transportation** cost = ₹400

**Repair** cost = ₹600

Selling Price (SP) = ₹9,800

**Formula Used:**

Total CP = Purchase Price + Overhead Expenses

Profit % = [(SP − Total CP) ÷ Total CP] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4845ae292933e748db1a5606b60ecaedc4fbc9fa925b82ea29f9bcbc134c098.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total **Investment** (Total CP) = 7000 + 400 + 600

⇒ Total CP = ₹8,000

⇒ Profit = SP − Total CP

⇒ Profit = 9800 − 8000 = ₹1,800

⇒ Profit % = (1800 ÷ 8000) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 180 ÷ 8 = 22.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 22.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overhead Charges

Expenses like transportation, repairs, and labor are always added to the purchase price to calculate the effective Cost Price.

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 and Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100. Both are always calculated on the Cost Price unless specified otherwise.

Selling Price Calculation

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100 or SP = CP × (100 − Loss%) ÷ 100.

questions.question: In a class, the average score of 8 boys is 56 and the average score of 4 girls is 80. What is the average score of all 12 students?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of number of **boys** to **girls** = 8 : 4 = 2 : 1.

Using **Weighted Average** method: Combined Average = (Ratio₁ × Avg₁ + Ratio₂ × Avg₂) ÷ (Total Ratio)

Combined Average = (2 × 56 + 1 × 80) ÷ (2 + 1)

Combined Average = (112 + 80) ÷ 3 = 192 ÷ 3 = 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of boys (n₁) = 8, Average score (a₁) = 56

Number of girls (n₂) = 4, Average score (a₂) = 80

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (Total sum of scores) ÷ (Total number of students)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44d3628b6b6e6d400d4d50d16d09d9b40eceb79da46ce744fdde008408b5a2aa.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total score of boys = 8 × 56 = 448

⇒ Total score of girls = 4 × 80 = 320

⇒ Total score of all students = 448 + 320 = 768

⇒ Total number of students = 8 + 4 = 12

⇒ Average score of all students = 768 ÷ 12 = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

It is used when groups of different sizes are combined: Avg = (n₁×a₁ + n₂×a₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Deviation Method

Pick an assumed mean (A), calculate deviations (d), then find the true average using: Average = A + (Σfᵢdᵢ ÷ Σfᵢ).

Combined Mean Property

The combined average always lies between the lowest and the highest individual group averages.

questions.question: If a two-digit number has a digit sum of 9 and adding 27 reverses its digits, determine the unit digit of the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **two-digit number**, the difference between its digits is equal to the change in value upon **reversing digits** divided by 9.

Difference between digits = 27 ÷ 9 = 3

Given **digit sum** = 9

Unit digit = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2 = (9 + 3) ÷ 2 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of digits of a **two-digit number** = 9

Number + 27 = Reversed Number

**Method:** Algebraic representation where tens digit is x and **unit digit** is y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6deab024ec54f8e255f51529f5bf9d01bd517b781fe8a2b500059afc06702e8f.png] 

Let the tens digit be x and the unit digit be y.

⇒ x + y = 9 ... (i)

⇒ The original number is 10x + y.

⇒ According to the problem: (10x + y) + 27 = 10y + x

⇒ 10x − x + y − 10y = −27

⇒ 9x − 9y = −27

⇒ x − y = −3 or y − x = 3 ... (ii)

⇒ Adding equation (i) and (ii): (x + y) + (y − x) = 9 + 3

⇒ 2y = 12

⇒ y = 6

⇒ x = 9 − 6 = 3

The number is 36 and its **unit digit** is 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Number Representation

A two-digit number with tens digit x and unit digit y is expressed as 10x + y. Its reversed form is 10y + x.

Difference Property

The difference between any two-digit number and its reverse is always a multiple of 9, specifically 9 × |x − y|.

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if and only if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

questions.question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹1,320 in 3 years at 20% per year rate of interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Interest Percentage** = Rate × Time = 20% × 3 = **60%**

Given: 60% of Principal = **₹1,320**

Principal (100%) = (1,320 ÷ 60) × 100

⇒ 22 × 100 = **₹2,200**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Simple Interest (SI) = **₹1,320**, Rate (R) = **20% per year**, Time (T) = **3 years**.

**Formula Used:** SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d94147b692613f6f239248a2f67e83a04dcef4d2e95d232e4dabe63ffdaa23ea.png] 

⇒ 1,320 = (P × 20 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 1,320 = (P × 60) ÷ 100

⇒ 1,320 = 0.6 × P

⇒ P = 1,320 ÷ 0.6

⇒ P = (1,320 × 10) ÷ 6

⇒ P = 220 × 10

⇒ P = **₹2,200**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) is the sum of **Principal** and **Interest**. Formula: A = P + SI or A = P(1 + RT/100).

Constant Nature of SI

Unlike Compound Interest, **Simple Interest** remains constant for every year as it is always calculated on the **original Principal** amount.

Relationship between P, R, T and SI

If SI, R, and T are known, **Principal** can be found using P = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T).
